summary_1line: Galava offers Madhavi to King Haryyaswa for rare horses; she bears him a son, regains virginity by boon, and moves on with Galava to seek more horses.

image_candidates.scene_text: Madhavi stands beside the sage Galava in the court of King Haryyaswa as the king studies her auspicious features and debates the price in rare white horses.
After bearing a son, Madhavi quietly departs the palace with Galava, miraculously restored to maidenhood while the king watches them leave.
Galava and the maiden Madhavi walk away from Ayodhya’s gates at dawn, setting out to seek another king who can pay in the rare black‑eared horses.
